H3V2VGranularFractionalDenoise.description: Full-source MiniMax H3 V2V latent with granular fractional video/audio denoise masks. Mask values can express continuous preserve-to-generate strength instead of only binary masking. V2V strength lives in the H3 mask; BasicScheduler denoise must remain 1.0. Near-1 mask precision compatibility is installed lazily and self-retires when ComfyUI provides it natively.

source_mask.tooltip: Spatial V2V mask for mode=spatial. 1 uses inside_strength; 0 uses outside_strength.

audio_strength.tooltip: 0 preserves source audio; 1 fully denoises/regenerates audio.

global_strength.tooltip: Native H3 video denoise-mask strength. Keep BasicScheduler denoise at 1.0.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent whose exact video/audio shape is reused.

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 model. The precision compatibility probe/patch is applied lazily only when this node executes.

source_audio.tooltip: Source audio matching source_frames. audio_strength=0 preserves it.

source_frames.tooltip: Full source video. It is converted deterministically to H3's 24 fps and encoded over the entire target latent.

H3V2VGranularFractionalDenoise.name: H3V2VGranularFractionalDenoise

MiniMaxH3AVBridgeTiming.description: Validate 24 fps H3 bridge timing before generation. Contexts use 39 + 51*k; targets use 5 + 17*k.
MiniMaxH3AVBridgeTiming.name: MiniMaxH3AVBridgeTiming

MiniMaxH3AVExtensionController.description: Workflow controller for the H3 AV Extension example. Its frontend companion applies real ComfyUI bypass mode to tagged groups; backend outputs drive lazy routing and the final streaming path.

active_extensions.tooltip: Generate Extensions 1..N. Later extension groups are automatically and visibly bypassed.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Audio latent-mask half-cosine feather. H3 audio latent rate is 40 Hz; 8 ticks = 0.2 seconds. 0 restores a hard audio mask.

previews.tooltip: Off disables all intermediate VHS previews. Last Active previews only the final enabled extension. All Active previews every enabled extension and the generated starter when applicable.

source_audio.tooltip: Existing Video only. Keep source audio preserves the original track (or exact-duration silence if none exists). Regenerate with H3 protects the complete source video and synthesizes a new synchronized soundtrack for the whole source clip before extension.

start.tooltip: Existing Video loads/extends a source clip. T2V generates a Ref2VA starter without a keyframe. I2V / Custom Keyframes enables the starter keyframe image at frame 1 (resolved frame index 0).

MiniMaxH3AVExtensionController.name: MiniMaxH3AVExtensionController

MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam.description: Internal cache-isolated AV Extension parameter. The frontend controller mirrors only the Source Audio widget here so unrelated controller changes cannot invalidate source audio.
MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam.display_name: H3 AV Source Audio Mode (Controller Internal)
MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam.name: MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam

MiniMaxH3AVStartModeParam.description: Internal cache-isolated AV Extension parameter. The frontend controller mirrors only the Start widget here so unrelated controller changes cannot invalidate extension samplers.
MiniMaxH3AVStartModeParam.name: MiniMaxH3AVStartModeParam

MiniMaxH3AssembleBridgeAudio.description: Trim the two protected H3 audio contexts, conform the generated middle to its 24 fps picture span, and concatenate source A + middle + source B on absolute sample boundaries.
MiniMaxH3AssembleBridgeAudio.name: MiniMaxH3AssembleBridgeAudio

MiniMaxH3AssembleExtension.description: Concatenate the canonical source and the trimmed H3 continuation. No crossfade: both audio pieces are resampled/matched to exact frame durations first so the join cannot accumulate AV drift.

crop.tooltip: Must match the crop setting used by H3 Existing Video Masked Context so the prepended source and conditioning tail use the identical spatial transform.

fps.tooltip: Use 24 for MiniMax H3. Audio is forced to the exact integer-sample duration implied by each image batch before concatenation.

source_frames.tooltip: Decoded source video frames. They are normalized to the same 24-fps mapping used by the context node.

MiniMaxH3AssembleExtension.name: MiniMaxH3AssembleExtension

MiniMaxH3AssembleInterior.description: Splice the canonical source frames and audio back over the interior preserved interval in the decoded H3 continuation. Hard-cut splice with exact AV accounting. Required output path for interior inserts because the causal VAE cannot exactly round-trip interior latent regions.

continuation_images.tooltip: Decoded H3 output frames (full timeline, all frames).

crop.tooltip: Must match the crop setting used by H3 Existing Video Masked Context.

insert_frame.tooltip: Wire from the insert_frame output of H3 Existing Video Masked Context.

preserved_frames.tooltip: Wire from the preserved_frames output of H3 Existing Video Masked Context.

source_frames.tooltip: Decoded source video frames. Normalized using the same 24-fps mapping the context node used.

MiniMaxH3AssembleInterior.name: MiniMaxH3AssembleInterior

MiniMaxH3AudioVAECompatibility.description: Route an H3 audio VAE through this node before stock H3 audio-reference nodes. Disables generic PCM center cropping only on an unfixed H3 AudioVAE instance. Already-fixed native VAEs are unchanged. Repo-owned audio encodes also do this lazily.
MiniMaxH3AudioVAECompatibility.name: MiniMaxH3AudioVAECompatibility

MiniMaxH3ClearAVNoiseMask.description: Remove the complete nested H3 AV noise mask without changing latent samples. Use this H3-aware node when clearing masks before H3 AV sampling or before rebuilding only one mask stream with H3 Set AV Noise Mask.
MiniMaxH3ClearAVNoiseMask.name: MiniMaxH3ClearAVNoiseMask

MiniMaxH3CropTo32.description: Center-crop source video frames down to the nearest width and height divisible by 32 and output the resulting dimensions for the H3 target.

images.tooltip: Source video frames. Width and height are cropped DOWN to the nearest multiple of 32.

MiniMaxH3CropTo32.name: MiniMaxH3CropTo32

MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframes.description: Pin still-image MiniMax H3 keyframes at arbitrary output-frame positions. Starts with 3 keyframes; use + Add keyframe to add more.

conditioning.tooltip: H3 conditioning. The node replaces its complete minimax_keyframes list with the keyframes below.

keyframe_state.tooltip: Internal UI state. Normally managed by the keyframe position controls.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent; defines resolution and exact frame count.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode each still.

MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframes.name: MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframes

MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframesMasked.description: Hard-preserve still-image keyframes by writing each encoded still directly into the target AV latent and masking those steps from denoising. Pinned positions must be phase-0 to pin exactly one frame: 1, 18, 35, 52, ... in the default 1-based mode; 0, 17, 34, 51, ... in 0-based mode. Interior positions pin the full containing latent step (up to 4 frames of latent protection; decoded pixels may differ). Existing nested H3 AV masks are preserved and merged; a keyframe may not overlap an already protected video step. Audio mask state is preserved unchanged.

keyframe_state.tooltip: Internal UI state. Normally managed by the keyframe position controls.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent; defines resolution and exact frame count.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode each still.

MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframesMasked.name: MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframesMasked

MiniMaxH3ExistingVideoMaskedContext.description: Prepare an existing decoded video as an exact preserved H3 AV segment. The source tail is normalized to H3 timing, VAE-encoded into the target latent at insert_frame, and protected with a per-stream denoise mask so H3 generates only the surrounding portions. Use H3 Assemble Interior Insert as the output path for interior inserts.

insert_frame.tooltip: Pixel frame where the preserved segment begins in the target latent. Snaps down to the nearest multiple of 17 (latent phase grid). Multiples of 51 also align the audio clock exactly. 0 is the original prefix behavior.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Half-cosine release across the final audio-latent context ticks. 0 = hard audio mask; 8 = 0.2 s at H3's 40 Hz audio latent rate.

context_length.tooltip: AV prefixes snap to shared H3 video+audio boundaries: 39/90/141/192/... frames.

latent.tooltip: Target H3 AV latent (for example from MiniMax H3 Reference to Video).

source_audio.tooltip: Audio from the same source video. Mono is duplicated to stereo; multichannel must be downmixed first.

source_fps.tooltip: Source-frame FPS. Use CFR or a decoder-normalized frame stream; the example forces 24 fps.

source_frames.tooltip: Decoded source video frames. The node converts CFR timing to H3's 24 fps.

MiniMaxH3ExistingVideoMaskedContext.name: MiniMaxH3ExistingVideoMaskedContext

MiniMaxH3ExtensionStartMode.description: One global switch for the masked AV extension workflow. The user-facing choice is mapped to the internal load_video/generate_starter mode used by the H3 context, canvas, and final-output nodes.

mode.tooltip: Choose once: generate a T2V/I2V starter, or extend an existing video. The workflow source-video group follows this choice automatically.

MiniMaxH3ExtensionStartMode.name: MiniMaxH3ExtensionStartMode

MiniMaxH3FanRecoveredContext.description: Fan the previous clip's recovered tail with the exact hold map used by the current H3 Time Smear. The repaired smear feeds the pass-2 init; the seam-nearest native-resolution guide and its exact dynamic target offset feed an interior H3 Motion Context guide.

context_frames.tooltip: Real-time starter frames to fan onto the smear clock.

hold_map.tooltip: hold_map_used from the SAME H3 Time Smear node.

source_context_images.tooltip: Previous clip's final recovered real-time context frames.

target_images.tooltip: Full smeared extension baseline on the de-rope clock.

MiniMaxH3FanRecoveredContext.name: MiniMaxH3FanRecoveredContext

MiniMaxH3FinalizeVHSOutput.description: Optional execution sink for H3 direct-stream outputs. Safe when the upstream final stream node is bypassed or disconnected.
MiniMaxH3FinalizeVHSOutput.name: MiniMaxH3FinalizeVHSOutput

MiniMaxH3GeneratedAVMaskedContext.description: Chain generated H3 clips without a decode/re-encode round trip. The previous clip's final joint video/audio latent run is copied into the new target prefix and protected with AV noise-mask 0; only the future region denoises.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Half-cosine release across the final audio-latent context ticks. 0 = hard audio mask; 8 = 0.2 s at H3's 40 Hz audio latent rate.

context_length.tooltip: Protected AV prefix. Snaps to shared 24-fps video / 40-Hz audio boundaries: 39/90/141/192/... frames.

latent.tooltip: Fresh target AV latent from MiniMax H3 Image/Reference to Video.

source_latent.tooltip: Previous generated H3 AV latent. Its final AV run is copied directly into the new target prefix.

MiniMaxH3GeneratedAVMaskedContext.name: MiniMaxH3GeneratedAVMaskedContext

MiniMaxH3LastActiveVHSPreviewBarrier.description: Execution-order barrier for H3 workflows. Set Input Count and click Update inputs to show only the preview sockets you need. It waits for the highest enabled VHS preview before final assembly.
MiniMaxH3LastActiveVHSPreviewBarrier.display_name: H3 Last Active VHS Preview Barrier

input_count.tooltip: Number of preview sockets shown by the node. Set this value, then click Update inputs.

MiniMaxH3LastActiveVHSPreviewBarrier.name: MiniMaxH3LastActiveVHSPreviewBarrier

MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge.description: Create a true two-ended H3 AV masked bridge. The ending of the first clip and beginning of the second clip are encoded into the target latent and protected with PR #15375-style video+audio denoise masks; only the middle is generated. 0 = preserve, 1 = denoise.

end_audio.tooltip: Audio matching end_frames. The first preserved interval is frozen at the bridge end.

end_fps.tooltip: Frame rate represented by end_frames. CFR input is converted deterministically to H3 24 fps.

end_frames.tooltip: Full second source clip or a frame batch containing its beginning. The first preserve_frames are frozen at the bridge end.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent. For example, use a 192-frame H3 latent.

preserve_frames.tooltip: Shared AV boundaries only: 39, 90, 141, 192, ... (39 + 51*k). The target must leave a generated middle.

start_audio.tooltip: Audio matching start_frames. The final preserved interval is frozen at the bridge start.

start_fps.tooltip: Frame rate represented by start_frames. CFR input is converted deterministically to H3 24 fps.

start_frames.tooltip: Full first source clip or a frame batch containing its ending. The final preserve_frames are frozen at the bridge start.

MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge.name: MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge

MiniMaxH3MotionContext.description: Pin a run of consecutive frames from a previous clip as never-denoised conditioning rows, so the model reads real motion instead of guessing it from a single still.

audio_vae.tooltip: H3 audio VAE. Supply with context_audio to carry the previous clip's tail sound across the join. Not needed when context_latent is wired.

context_audio.tooltip: Audio of the previous clip. The tail matching the pinned frames is encoded and pinned alongside them. Ignored when context_latent is wired.

context_latent.tooltip: Previous clip's SAMPLER OUTPUT latent (the same one you wire into the decode nodes). When supplied, the pinned audio is sliced straight from it, skipping the decode/re-encode round trip that dulls sound a little more at every link of a chain. Takes priority over context_audio; audio_vae is not needed on this path.

anchor_mode.tooltip: head uses native ComfyUI guide semantics; target_start controls where the guide begins. before is a legacy mode and is rejected on native core.

audio_context_length.tooltip: Frames of tail audio to pin. 0 follows context_length; timeline mode end-aligns it with the visual context.

audio_mode.tooltip: timeline: pinned audio gets coordinates on this clip's own timeline, end-aligned with the pinned video, so the model reads it as this clip's sound so far and continues it. ref: stock placement in a span before the clip, which the model imitates (similar music, not phase-locked) rather than continues.

context_length.tooltip: Any frame count. 39 recommended; 90 for long context. 39/90/141/... align exactly to H3 video+audio timing.

encode_mode.tooltip: video: one VAE call, motion lives inside the latent, fewer rows. frames: one call per frame, each pinned as a separate still.

target_start.tooltip: Target frame where this motion guide begins. 0 preserves normal head-context behavior; a positive offset places the guide inside the target timeline and returns trim_frames=0.

MiniMaxH3MotionContext.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContext

MiniMaxH3MotionContextLoadLatent.description: Load a latent saved by H3 Motion Context Save Latent, for the context_latent input only.

clip_index.tooltip: The clip to CONTINUE FROM: that clip's slot is loaded. Generating clip 2 from clip 1: set 1 here and 2 on the Save node. 0 = newest file in the folder (NOT retry-safe: a re-roll loads its own rejected audio).

latent_path.tooltip: A saved latent file, or a folder (relative paths resolve against the ComfyUI output directory). Pointing at a specific FILE always loads that file, ignoring clip_index.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextLoadLatent.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextLoadLatent

MiniMaxH3MotionContextSaveLatent.description: Save the sampler's AV latent so the next run's Motion Context node can pin audio from it via the matching Load node.

clip_index.tooltip: Which clip of the chain THIS is. Saves to that clip's fixed slot, so a re-roll overwrites its own reject instead of stacking new files. Generating clip 2: set 2 here and 1 on the Load node. 0 = old behaviour, a new numbered file every run (numbers count runs, not clips).

filename_prefix.tooltip: Saved under the ComfyUI output folder. The default keeps all chain latents in one folder so the Load node can always pick the newest.

latent.tooltip: The sampler's output latent (the same one you wire into the decode nodes).

MiniMaxH3MotionContextSaveLatent.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextSaveLatent

MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim.description: Remove the leading pinned frames from a decoded H3 clip, trimming picture and sound by the same duration.

audio.tooltip: Decoded audio for the same clip. Trimmed by the matching duration so sound stays locked to picture. Leave unwired for silent clips.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate used to convert the trim into an audio duration. Must match what you feed Create Video.

match_tail.tooltip: Time-conform decoded audio so its duration equals frames/fps exactly. H3's 40-Hz audio grid can land a few milliseconds before or after a 24-fps picture boundary; this prevents that drift from accumulating across chained clips.

video_crossfade_frames.tooltip: Video overlap retained for final KJ crossfade. Audio still trims the full context.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim

MiniMaxH3MusicVideoController.description: Workflow controller for the checkpoint-free H3 Music Video example. Its frontend companion applies real ComfyUI bypass mode to tagged clip/preview groups and mirrors Active Clips into a cache-isolated execution parameter.

active_clips.tooltip: Generate Clip 1 through Clip N. Later clip groups are automatically and visibly bypassed.

previews.tooltip: Off disables all clip previews. Last Active previews only the final enabled clip. All Active previews every enabled clip.

MiniMaxH3MusicVideoController.name: MiniMaxH3MusicVideoController

MiniMaxH3OptionalReferenceImage.description: Optional global image-reference slot. Disabled slots return None and are ignored by native MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.

image.tooltip: Connect a Load Image node here only when this global reference slot is needed.

enabled.tooltip: When off, returns None and does not evaluate the optional image branch. MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo ignores None reference entries.

MiniMaxH3OptionalReferenceImage.name: MiniMaxH3OptionalReferenceImage

MiniMaxH3OptionalStartFrame.description: Optional starter first frame: disabled gives T2V, enabled gives I2V.

image.tooltip: Connect Load Image here for I2V. The branch is not evaluated while disabled.

enabled.tooltip: Off = T2V starter. On = use the connected image as the I2V first frame.

MiniMaxH3OptionalStartFrame.name: MiniMaxH3OptionalStartFrame

MiniMaxH3SetAVNoiseMask.description: Set video and/or audio denoise masks on a MiniMax H3 AV latent using the required two-stream NestedTensor format. Use this instead of ComfyUI's stock Set Latent Noise Mask for H3 AV latents; a stock single-tensor mask can drop the audio mask stream and unintentionally regenerate protected audio.
MiniMaxH3SetAVNoiseMask.name: MiniMaxH3SetAVNoiseMask

MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext.description: Write an exact master-song slice into the target H3 audio latent and protect the entire audio stream from denoising. For continuations, prefer a previous live H3 source_latent so the video tail is copied directly without decode/re-encode.
MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext.display_name: H3 Song Audio + Masked Video Context

source_frames.tooltip: Legacy decoded-frame continuation path. Prefer source_latent for checkpoint-free live clip chaining.

source_latent.tooltip: Preferred live continuation input. Copies the previous H3 video latent tail directly into the new target while the master-song audio slice remains authoritative.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE. Required only for the legacy source_frames continuation path.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE. Used to encode the master-song slice into the target audio latent.

clip_start_seconds.tooltip: Start time of this raw clip within the master song timeline. For clip N, this usually advances by raw_clip_seconds - context_seconds from the previous clip.

context_length.tooltip: Optional preserved visual prefix from the previous clip. Uses exact H3 runs 5/22/39/56/...; 0 disables visual prefixing entirely.

latent.tooltip: Target AV latent from MiniMax H3 Reference to Video.

master_audio.tooltip: Full master song or master vocal audio. The node writes the exact requested slice into the H3 latent and protects it from denoising.

source_fps.tooltip: FPS of source_frames when visual context is connected.

MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext.name: MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPolicy.description: Source-audio policy for AV Extensions. Keep mode reads the source file directly with ffmpeg; a genuinely missing audio stream becomes exact-duration silence. The VHS source loader audio output must stay unconnected. Regenerate mode decodes a soundtrack generated by H3 across the complete source clip.

regenerated_latent.tooltip: Sampler output from H3 Source Audio Regen Mask. Requested only in Regenerate with H3 mode.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE; used to decode regenerated source audio.

source_frames.tooltip: Source frames used to derive the exact final audio duration.

video_info.tooltip: Connect the source VHS video loader's video_info. The VHS audio socket must remain unconnected; this link identifies the selected source file safely.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPolicy.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPolicy

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenLength.description: For full source-audio regeneration, converts the source duration to 24 fps and pads only the end to the next native H3 video-VAE length (5, 22, 39, ...).

source_frames.tooltip: Source video frames. The count is normalized to H3's 24 fps timeline before padding to an exact H3 run.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenLength.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenLength

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenMask.description: Full-source H3 audio regeneration mask. The complete source video is encoded and protected with video mask 0 while the complete H3 audio stream keeps mask 1. H3 therefore regenerates soundtrack only, without changing source video pixels.

latent.tooltip: Fresh H3 AV latent whose length is driven by H3 Source Audio Regen Length.

source_frames.tooltip: The complete source video. All visual latent steps are protected; only audio is regenerated.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenMask.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenMask

MiniMaxH3StartCanvasSelector.description: Choose one shared H3 generation canvas for the masked AV extension workflow. In load_video mode it reuses the cropped source-video size; in generate_starter mode it uses the manual starter width/height.

source_height.tooltip: Height from H3 Crop Source To /32. Requested only in load_video mode.

source_width.tooltip: Width from H3 Crop Source To /32. Requested only in load_video mode.

start_mode.tooltip: Connect H3 Extension Start Mode. load_video = use the cropped source-video canvas; generate_starter = use the manual width/height below.

MiniMaxH3StartCanvasSelector.name: MiniMaxH3StartCanvasSelector

MiniMaxH3StartMaskedContext.description: Checkpoint-free Extension-1 start selector. Existing Video requests decoded source AV; T2V/I2V request the live generated starter latent.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE; used for existing-video starts.

latent.tooltip: Fresh target AV latent for Extension 1.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE; used for existing-video starts.

MiniMaxH3StartMaskedContext.name: MiniMaxH3StartMaskedContext

MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS.description: Modular low-RAM AV Extension final output. Set Input Count and click Update inputs to expose as many extension latent sockets as needed. Disconnected sockets are skipped. Clips are decoded one at a time and streamed directly into VHS without materializing the full RGB movie.
MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS.display_name: H3 Stream AV Extensions to VHS

active_extensions.tooltip: Optional cap on extension sockets considered. Leave unconnected for modular/custom workflows.

input_count.tooltip: Number of extension latent sockets shown by the node. Set this value, then click Update inputs.

MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS.name: MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS

MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS.description: Modular low-RAM final Music Video output. Set Input Count and click Update inputs to expose clip latent sockets. Standalone workflows may leave trailing sockets disconnected; connected clips must remain a contiguous prefix because each clip belongs to a fixed master-song window. Clips are decoded one at a time and the untouched master song is muxed.
MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS.display_name: H3 Stream Final Music Video to VHS

active_clips.tooltip: Optional cap on clip sockets considered. Leave unconnected for modular/custom workflows.

input_count.tooltip: Number of clip latent sockets shown by the node. Set this value, then click Update inputs.

MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS.name: MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS

MiniMaxH3Validate24FPSVideo.description: Require a 24 fps source and loaded frame batch for current H3 workflows. Convert the source to constant 24 fps before loading it. VHS metadata cannot certify VFR timing.
MiniMaxH3Validate24FPSVideo.name: MiniMaxH3Validate24FPSVideo
